import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        boolean[] visitedNodes = new boolean[p];
        int cycleTotal = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) {
            if (!visitedNodes[i]) {
                cycleTotal++;
                int currentNode = i;
                do {
                    visitedNodes[currentNode] = true;
                    currentNode = (int)(((long) currentNode * k) % p);
                } while (!visitedNodes[currentNode]);
            }
        }

        long answerValue = 1;
        int limit = cycleTotal + (k == 1 ? 1 : 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < limit; i++) {
            answerValue = (answerValue * p) % 1000000007;
        }
        System.out.println(answerValue);
        sc.close();
    }
}
